licenseCheck.interpretation: GitHub reports no detectable license file for the upstream repository as of 2026-10-14. The baseline quotes only short official release and changelog sentences for factual tracking and copies no upstream code.

algorithmDisclosure.note: The official release note and changelog describe the feature and two follow-up changes but not how the side agent selects, gates, deduplicates, or formats notes. No reverse engineering is attempted.
